# A quieter way to read Markdown

Open a local file and get straight to the document. FastMarkdownViewer brings
**tables**, *math*, code, and an outline into a native desktop window.

## Keep your place

Use tabs for related documents, **Ctrl+F** to find a phrase, and the outline to
jump between sections. Your open files and reading positions return next time.

| Reading tool | Try it |
| :--- | :--- |
| Find | Search text, code, and link captions |
| Outline | Jump to a heading without scrolling |
| Appearance | Choose a theme, font, and text size |

## Code and equations

```rust
fn main() {
    let document = "notes.md";
    println!("Ready to read {document}");
}
```

Inline math stays with the text: $E = mc^2$.

## Reading across languages

日本語 · 中文 · 한국어 · हिन्दी · ภาษาไทย · Café · Ελληνικά · Українська 🙂
